rationale: The message reports concrete findings from probes, listing observed defaults and option behaviors. It also combines multiple probe results into one consolidated summary, so result_delivery is primary with evidence_observation/synthesis secondary.

evidence.text: Probes: flatten default labels  etc, records separated ; -n labels 0,1; -c 3 truncates →. table default uses 2 spaces and widths; fmt -t '|' outputs delimiter, --crlf line endings, --quote-always quotes all, --ascii uses 0x1f fields/0x1e records, --quote ' uses single quote and strips unnecessary quoting.
stats default columns field,type,sum,min,max,min_length,max_length,mean,stddev; --everything adds median,mode,cardinality. frequency output field,value,count with NULL marker .
